brief: Three camera/sill loose ends, all measured, none built. (1) c129: in the Far bank quarter on a desktop the willow's fronds hang under the foreground sill strip (rows 48+ at 2.6×) — re-price QUARTERS[4]'s box with project() on the target frame (the share law: share sets s from WIDTH, so fix rows by the box, not the share) so the island and its willow are inside the frame on a 1400 px desktop and a phone alike. (2) c126: viewFor()'s east clamp is priced at the bottom row (p = 1); price it at the box's OWN top row so a quarter near the top of the world can never show void past GW, and let Plaza take share ≥ 0.5 at 1400 px if it then fits. (3) c134: the clock-tower vane's cardinal letters are 6 px CSS at every zoom — scale them with cellW (floor 6 px) so a phone quarter at s 3.5 reads them; and let the wind announcement name the vane's heading via vaneName(). Prove each with probes/where-identity (IDENTICAL on Wide) and a before/after crop.
successLooksLike: Far bank quarter shows rows 0..52 on a 1400×900 desktop and on a 390×844 phone (project() of EYOT_AT.y + ry lands above the sill strip); no quarter box's right edge projects past GW at its top row; the vane letters measure ≥ cellW·1.7 px at s 3.5; the wide frame is IDENTICAL to HEAD; a wind announcement reads '…the weathercock swings into a west wind'.
avoid: Do not move FOCUS or touch gview's k mapping. Do not add a new offer to OFFERS. No new quarter.
